_comment: Captured from doc-detective 4.37.1 (`npx doc-detective --input <page>`) against a page with one runShell step asserting exitCodes [0] on a command that exits 7. Trimmed to the fields the adapter reads. Note the FAIL status repeats at every nesting level — spec, test, context, step, and assertion — which is what collectFailures must not double-count.

steps.description: A step that fails on purpose.
